title: Daily digest: KTR extends support to protesting medica | Somireddy Wants Unanimous Panchayat Poll | HYDRAA To Expand Krishna Kanth Park Lake | Natural Deliveries Benefit Mother, Child | Mayor-Elect Sravani To Skip Oath-Taking
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: KTR extends support to protesting medical students in Karimnagar.
Somireddy Wants Unanimous Panchayat Polls for Incentives.
HYDRAA To Expand Krishna Kanth Park Lake To 12 Acres To Curb Flooding.
Mayor-Elect Sravani To Skip Oath-Taking Ceremony On Monday.
bullets_ur: KTR ne Karimnagar mein ehtijaj karne walay medical talba ki himayat ka elaan kar diya.
Somireddy chahte hain ke inaamat ke liye panchayat intikhabat bil-ittefaq hon.
Sailab roknay ke liye HYDRAA Krishna Kanth Park ki jheel ko 12 acre tak barhayega.
Qudrati waz-e-hamal maan aur bachay dono ke liye faida-mand hota hai.
Noor-e-nazar Mayor Sravani somwar ko half uthanay ki taqreeb mein shirkat nahi karengi.
